title: Bound merge-gate output capture and cancellation without losing child ownership
description:
## Source-confirmed performance/lifetime gap

`crates/thegn-host/src/integrate.rs::gate_tip` runs setup and gate through `Command::output()`. Both complete stdout and stderr are buffered until exit, then copied/UTF-8 converted and tail-truncated. THE-589 bounds retained diagnostics, not this initial allocation. A noisy gate can grow host memory without bound. No gate-specific deadline was found; a child/grandchild retaining a pipe can prevent completion and keep the reusable gate lease indefinitely.

## Scope

Introduce bounded streaming tail capture for both channels, explicit operator-configurable setup/gate deadlines or a documented disabled deadline, and cancellation that retains ownership through process-group termination/reaping and pipe-reader settlement. Do not signal reaped/reused PIDs or detach unbounded reader threads. OS/filesystem blocking limits must be described honestly. Preserve gate exit classification: timeout/transport/setup failures are infrastructure holds, never candidate blame or pass. Do not change the user's configured gate command or silently impose a short build deadline.

## Acceptance

Private tests with large output on both streams, split UTF-8, endless writer, child exit with grandchild-held pipes, ignored termination, cancellation, spawn/reaper failure and ordinary pass/red exit. Assert bounded memory/retained diagnostics, no transient landed outcome, no lease reuse while previous workload remains, and no unrelated process signalling. Native fixture command-level timeout is not proof of production gate cancellation.

## Priority and limits

Separate follow-up, not established as THE-586 original failure cause. The configured local full test gate previously passed on an identical metadata-only tree. No production configuration mutation or live noisy-command test authorized.
